title: Inside the Entourage Finds collection: sculptural metal and detailed antiques
description: A closer look at Entourage Finds on PatinaHall — a collection that moves between periods and design traditions, from sculptural metal seating to richly detailed antique furniture.
label: Store update

sections.heading: A collection worth a second look
paragraphs: Entourage Finds brings another distinctive collection of vintage and antique furniture to our growing European marketplace, and it rewards browsing slowly.

The collection brings together different periods and design traditions, from sculptural metal seating to richly detailed antique furniture. Each piece offers something beyond the ordinary, whether it is an unusual silhouette, beautiful craftsmanship or a story carried through time.

sections.heading: Independent dealers, without the second catalogue
paragraphs: At PatinaHall we believe independent dealers deserve to reach more people without the burden of managing yet another catalogue. That is why we work to keep collections connected to the shops that own them, so what appears here follows the dealer's own catalogue instead of being retyped and left to go stale.

sections.heading: Furniture with its own character
paragraphs: Explore Entourage Finds on PatinaHall and discover furniture with its own character and history — pieces chosen by someone who had to decide, in person, that they were worth carrying home.
PatinaHall is a marketplace for vintage furniture, and the dealers are the reason it is worth visiting.
